Peddireddy Rajashekara Rao, ...PETITIONER  AND The State Of Andhra Pradesh and Others ...RESPONDENT(S)

 2. 15516/GP FOR HOME (AP)
The Court made the following:
ORDER:
-
Heard Ms. G. Priyanka, learned counsel, representing Mr. V.V.Satish, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader, Home for the respondents 1 to 5/ police.

2. The petitioner questioning the action of the 2nd respondent in not taking any action on the representation of the petitioner dated 12.09.2014 as illegal and also requested to direct the 2nd respondent to take action against the respondents 4 to 9.

sentences.text: Today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home for the respondents 1 to 5, on instructions, categorically submitted that during pendency of the writ petition, the respondents/ police registered a case in Crime No. 70 of 2014 against the petitioner under Section 420 of IPC and investigated into.

During the course of investigation, 7th respondent appeared before the 4th respondent on 06.10.2014 and submitted a Notarized Affidavit regarding withdrawal of complaint duly signed by him and elders and wanted to withdraw the criminal case.
The petitioner has also agreed to withdrawn the case filed against him before the court at Yanam.
Therefore he requested to drop further action in the case.
The 3rd respondent took up further investigation in this case and after due verification he came to a conclusion that the case is "civil in nature'.

Later the case was referred as 'civil in nature vide proceedings dated 29.03.2015 and submitted final report before the Judicial Magistrate of I Class, Pithapuram and obtained refer proceedings vide R.C.No.7 of 2016.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of I Class, Pithapuram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The respondents/ police never infringed the personal liberty of the petitioner during the investigation.
Therefore, requested to close the writ petition.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that she has no information with regard to status of the case from the petitioner.
5. Recording the submissions of both the counsel, this Writ Petition is closed. There shall be no order as to costs.

The miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall also stand closed.

2. The petitioner questioning the action of the 2nd respondent in not taking any action on the representation of the petitioner dated 12.09.2014 as illegal and also requested to direct the 2nd respondent to take action against the respondents 4 to 9.
Today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home for the respondents 1 to 5, on instructions, categorically submitted that during pendency of the writ petition, the respondents/ police registered a case in Crime No. 70 of 2014 against the petitioner under Section 420 of IPC and investigated into.
During the course of investigation, 7th respondent appeared before the 4th respondent on 06.10.2014 and submitted a Notarized Affidavit regarding withdrawal of complaint duly signed by him and elders and wanted to withdraw the criminal case.
The respondents/ police never infringed the personal liberty of the petitioner during the investigation.
Therefore, requested to close the writ petition.
